name: Remove a product from the cart

steps.name: Given I am logged in as a standard user
When I add "Sauce Labs Backpack" to the cart
Click locator('.inventory_item').filter({ hasText: 'Sauce Labs Backpack' }).locator('button').filter({ hasText: 'Add to cart' })
And I remove "Sauce Labs Backpack" from the cart
Click locator('.inventory_item').filter({ hasText: 'Sauce Labs Backpack' }).locator('button').filter({ hasText: 'Remove' })
Then the cart should be empty
